app.description: The app's name: the manifest and release parameters default to /<app>/<stage>/deploy and /<app>/<stage>/release.

container.description: Defaults to the task definition's first container.

images.description: Image per service or task name, or * for all. Variables: ${registry} ${name} ${sha} ${app} ${stage}.

skip_unless_changed.description: Gitignore-style patterns over the files changed since the released commit; a deploy with no matching change does nothing. !pattern excludes.

drain.description: Wait until no task started by started_by is running: work a restart would lose.

exec.description: A shell command; non-zero stops the deploy.

before_roll.description: Gates run after registering and before the release command and rollout, in order.

task.description: A service or task name from the manifest; its new revision runs.

timeout.description: How long it may run before it's stopped. Default 30m.

wait.description: How long to wait for another deploy's release task to finish. Default 30m.

release.description: A one-off task run before the rollout, one at a time per app: migrations.

revision.description: Dot path into the JSON body (.revision, .build.sha) that must equal the deployed commit; a prefix of 7 or more characters matches.

health.description: Endpoints that must answer, and report the deployed commit, once every service has rolled.

smoke.description: Requests that must get the expected answer before a deploy is recorded as a release.

on_failure.description: rollback: a failed rollout, health check or smoke test returns the services to the current release.

console.description: The one-off task ecsd console starts.

verify_image.description: Required. A shell command run for every image before it's deployed or rolled back to, with ECSD_IMAGE set (pinned to its digest); non-zero stops the deploy. none deploys images unverified, and says so on every deploy.

any_registry.description: Images may come from outside the manifest's registry.

unpinned.description: Images outside ECR may be deployed by tag. ECR tags are always resolved to digests.

image_policy.description: Opt-outs from the image rules: every image is in the manifest's registry, and pinned to a digest (ECR tags are resolved).

roll.description: Per service, until its deployment completes and its old tasks are gone. Default 20m.

title: ecsd.yml
description: What ecsd deploys: images, gates, the release task, health and smoke checks.
